title: b6.sog.proposal v1 — read-only SOG analysis proposal (FROZEN 2026-07-16)
description: Event payload produced by the B6 SOG analyzer. FROZEN: any change requires a new file b6.sog.proposal.v2.json — never edit this file. Red line: this event carries ZERO write authority — no mutation, no kill, no self-heal, no budget write, no secret access, no direct ledger write. Consumers MUST treat it as a refusable proposal; routing policy maps it to SHADOW_LOG (observe) and any apply-path to REQUIRE_APPROVAL via P3 TELEGRAM verdict.

producer.description: agent_id of the analyzer process (e.g. b6_sog). Must match the registered channel id in control_plane/registry.yaml when wired.

authority.description: Hard-coded authority declaration; validators reject any other value.

model_version.description: Version/commit of the SOG math core (core/model.py lineage) that produced this analysis.

anchor_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical anchor set used (E_shadow / Δ_self / identity=0.135073). Guards against silent anchor drift between analyzer and consumer.

idempotency_key.description: sha256(producer + '|' + input snapshot content hash + '|' + model_version). Consumers MUST dedup on this key; replays are no-ops.

input_snapshot.description: Descriptor of the read-only snapshot analyzed. Paths and hashes only — NEVER raw content, NEVER secrets.

kind.description: What the analyzer claims. None of these kinds implies execution.

suggested_next.description: Human-readable suggestion for the owner. Informational only — policy routes any apply to REQUIRE_APPROVAL.
